title: Terms on which Client Subsidy Funding is Taken onto a Micro Market Agreement
content:
Client subsidy for an Unattended Micro Market Program market is funded in advance in lots, and each lot is recorded against the agreement so that kiosk discounts can be traced back to the money that paid for them.

## Size of a lot

The clause reading "A lot may not be smaller than the minimum funding lot printed against the market format, and a client wishing to fund less is asked to combine the amount into the next lot." is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis on which the size of a lot is worked out.

## Drawable life

A lot stays drawable for the number of months printed against the market format, counted from the day the funding cleared, and lapses at the end of that period with the unspent balance credited on the next settlement invoice.

## When funding is accepted

Funding is only accepted onto an agreement that stands installing, active or suspended, since a proposal has no kiosk to spend it at and a closed agreement is being settled out rather than funded. The standing consulted is the one the company's records show for that agreement, together with the subsidy funding already standing on it, before the lot is taken.

| Standing of the agreement | Funding accepted |
| --- | --- |
| proposed | not accepted |
| installing | accepted |
| active | accepted |
| suspended | accepted |
| closed | not accepted |

## Formats that take no funding

A market format whose subsidy model is one that meets nothing takes no funding at all, and a client wishing to discount employee purchases there is moved to a format whose subsidy model permits it. Funding paid in for one site's market is never drawn at another site's market, even where the same client holds both.

superseded_clauses: A lot may not be smaller than the minimum funding lot printed against the market format, and a client wishing to fund less is asked to combine the amount into the next lot.
